result: automated gates passed; superseded before acceptance after native visual review
preview_screens: All ten required preview views rendered correctly; managed AUI pages and native visibility assertions passed.
remaining_visual_failure: Live navigation regression captures showed the route summary at the bottom-left over the Navigation button after the initial narrow window expanded. Showing a previously hidden sizer item did not relayout its parent.
fix: Relayout the bottom row when the route label changes text or visibility. Add a native narrow-to-wide resize assertion checking actual label/button bounds.
additional_package_audit: Portable plugin loader searched profile/plugins, which was absent, although the platform log mentioned app/plugins. Saved enabled preferences alone did not establish DLL initialization.
plugin_fix: Bundle the installed plugins and data into the upstream portable profile/plugins location; require Dashboard discovery and completed initialized lifecycle in all normal package launches, with no initialization in Safe.
long_path_observation: SVG bitmap cache writes can exceed legacy Windows path limits under the long CI extraction path. In-memory icon rendering continues; a short extraction path is documented. No upstream cache implementation change.
